title: Glowing pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#aaffcc' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#aaffcc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id='blur'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='2.5'/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- glow behind blades -->
  <g filter='url(#blur)' opacity='0.6'>
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='26' y2='16' stroke='#7dffcc' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='74' y2='16' stroke='#7dffcc' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- blade 1 -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='24' y2='14' stroke='#c8f0ff' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='24' y2='14' stroke='#eafffb' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blade 2 -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='76' y2='14' stroke='#b0e0ff' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='76' y2='14' stroke='#dff4ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blade tips highlight -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='14' r='3' fill='#f0fffa'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='14' r='3' fill='#e0f4ff'/>
  <!-- pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5.5' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5.5' fill='none' stroke='#fff2b0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- handle 1 -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='76' rx='13' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ff6699' stroke-width='7'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='76' rx='13' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffaacc' stroke-width='3' transform='translate(-1 -1)'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='56' x2='38' y2='64' stroke='#ff6699' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='56' x2='38' y2='64' stroke='#ffaacc' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle 2 -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='76' rx='13' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ff8844' stroke-width='7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='76' rx='13' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffbb88' stroke-width='3' transform='translate(1 -1)'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='56' x2='62' y2='64' stroke='#ff8844' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='56' x2='62' y2='64' stroke='#ffbb88' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#eaffff'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='1.3'/>
  </g>
</svg>
